subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Fire as a help and a danger; how to put out a fire; potentially dangerous objects and cutlery

show.line: Fire cooks our food and keeps us warm. But fire can burn. Be careful!

rounds.prompt: You find matches. What do you do?
Who comes to put out a big fire?
Safe for children, or not? Sort them.
If your clothes catch fire, stop, drop and...?

hints: Fire is hot. Only grown-ups use it.
Stop, drop and roll puts out flames on clothes.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I found some matches.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will play with the matches!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Matches go to a grown-up.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Never play with matches. Give them to a grown-up!

parent_line: Knows fire helps and harms, and never to play with matches.
